channel.title: Nobita Talks AI
channel.description: Focusing on AI foundation models and tech insights

item.title: AI Agent Memory Architecture: From Working Memory to Episodic Memory & Hierarchical Graph RAG
item.description: Why multi-million token context windows still fail to solve agent amnesia. A deep architectural dissection of the three-tier memory pyramid (Working, Episodic, and Long-Term Semantic Memory), Stanford Generative Agents reflection cycles, Letta (MemGPT) virtual paging, and runnable code with decay curves and hybrid retrieval.

item.title: Agentic Loops & State Machine Design: From ReAct to Deterministic Control Flows
item.description: Why prompt chaining and unconstrained ReAct loops fail in production AI systems. A deep architectural dissection of agent failure modes, Finite State Machine (FSM) graph flows, tool-calling resilience, and circuit breakers with runnable code.

item.title: Under the Hood of Browser-use (100k+ Stars): DOM Tree Distillation, Vision Grounding, and Production Web Agents
item.description: Why do traditional Selenium and Playwright scripts constantly break against modern web frontends? We dissect the architecture of Browser-use, the breakout open-source project with over 100k GitHub stars: DOM tree pruning, Set-of-Mark (SoM) visual coordinate grounding, state machine resilience, and end-to-end production recipes.

item.title: SGLang vs vLLM Architecture Showdown: RadixAttention, Structured Decoding, and High-Concurrency Benchmarks
item.description: A deep architectural breakdown between the dual titans of 2026 LLM inference: vLLM and SGLang. We dissect PagedAttention block paging versus RadixAttention tree-based prefix caching, compare scheduler-level structured decoding (JSON Schema) mechanics, and deliver rigorous benchmarks on an 8x H100 cluster alongside an enterprise decision framework.

item.title: Speculative Decoding in Production: From Draft Models to EAGLE-3 Dynamic Trees for 3x-5x Lossless Acceleration
item.description: Why is autoregressive LLM decoding fundamentally bottlenecked by memory bandwidth? We dissect the mathematical proof of lossless distribution invariance in speculative decoding, trace its evolution from dual-model drafts to EAGLE-2/3 dynamic draft trees, and provide production configurations in vLLM and SGLang.

item.title: Test-Time Compute and GRPO in Practice: From PPO to Critic-Free Reinforcement Learning
item.description: A deep dive into the paradigm shift from pre-training scaling laws to test-time compute. We deconstruct the mathematical derivation of DeepSeek-R1's Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), critic-free architecture advantages, emergent self-reflection in long reasoning traces, and a complete, reproducible hands-on implementation.

item.title: Deploying 2026 Frontier Open Models On-Premise: Running DeepSeek-V4 and Kimi K3 on Multi-Node GPU Clusters
item.description: Complete enterprise on-premise deployment guide for 1.6T - 2.8T MoE open-weight models: Hardware planning across GPU clusters, vLLM / SGLang distributed TP/PP configuration, FP8 dynamic quantization, and high-concurrency API gateway production setups.

item.title: 2026 Frontier Chinese LLMs Face-off: Kimi K3 vs GLM-5.3 vs DeepSeek-V4 Practical Benchmark & Architecture Selection
item.description: In-depth evaluation of China's top three frontier models in 2026: Kimi K3's 2.8T KDA attention, GLM-5.3's environment-scaled terminal execution, and DeepSeek-V4-Pro's 1.6T MoE software engineering prowess.

item.title: Beyond Simple Prompts: How Environment Scaling Is Reshaping Autonomous Agents in 2026
item.description: Analyzing the major post-training paradigm shift of 2026: from text autoregression to multi-environment sandboxed RL. Deep dive into GLM-5.3's Terminal-Bench 3.0 breakthrough, Linux container orchestration, MCP protocol integration, and sandboxed agent engineering.

item.title: Demystifying 2026 Architecture Breakthroughs: How Kimi Delta Attention and DeepSeek MLA Conquered the Memory Wall
item.description: In the era of million-token context windows and trillion-parameter MoE, how KV Cache memory saturation became the core bottleneck. Deep mathematical and architectural breakdown of Moonshot's KDA and DeepSeek's MLA low-rank projections.

item.title: Evolving Models at Runtime: From Basic Reflection to MCTS-based Test-Time Compute
item.description: The potential of LLMs extends beyond pre-trained parameters. We dive deep into the frontier of Test-Time Compute: from Actor-Critic architecture to leveraging Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) to decode the limits of Agent self-correction.

item.title: 2026 AI Paradigm Shift: Distributed Agent Orchestration & Evals to Combat Error Compounding
item.description: As LLMs move into complex enterprise production, how do we use distributed orchestration to combat error compounding? How do we build a statistically significant Evals system?

item.title: Deep Dive into AI Agent Architecture Evolution: From Prompt to Loop Engineering
item.description: A deep dive into the evolution of AI Agent architectures, exploring the 4-layer control plane extrapolation from Prompt, Context, Harness to Loop Engineering, and the 4 diseases of the ReAct architecture.

item.title: Agent Observability & Debugging: The Path from Black Box to White Box
item.description: AI Agents are not traditional software; we are debugging the reasoning process rather than the code itself. This article explores Trajectory Evaluation, LLM-as-a-Judge, and practical applications of mainstream Agent observability tools like LangSmith and Langfuse.

item.title: Context Engineering Guide: Managing Context Window like RAM
item.description: The hottest concept in 2026, evolving from Prompt Engineering to Context Engineering. A deep dive into managing the context window through Write, Select, Compress, and Isolate strategies to solve long-context amnesia, hallucinations, and context poisoning.

item.title: AI Coding Mastery: From 'Build Me an X' to Architecture Orchestrator
item.description: Tools don't matter — methodology does. A deep dive into six core methods for mastering AI coding: Spec-Driven Development, Context Engineering, TDD Verification Loops, Multi-Agent Orchestration, Advanced Prompting, and Session Hygiene. Plus a 20+ tool matrix and five anti-patterns to avoid.

item.title: Reject Benchmark Hacking: How to Build an LLM Evaluation System for Your Business (LLM-as-a-Judge)
item.description: Cease the obsession with writing more code; shift focus to deep evaluation thinking. We deconstruct LLM-as-a-Judge biases, the mathematics behind metrics, and reshaping CI/CD defenses for probabilistic systems.

item.title: LLM Quantization Hands-On Guide: Four Routes from Zero to Production
item.description: Hands-on LLM quantization guide: download and run GGUF models (Qwen3-8B-Q4_K_M.gguf, llama.cpp, Ollama), quantize with AWQ/GPTQ, and deploy vLLM FP8 in production with copy-paste code.

item.title: The Critical Crossroads in AI History: Why Was *That One* Chosen Every Time?
item.description: A retrospective of six pivotal technology crossroads in AI's seventy-year history, dissecting the compute constraints, data dividends, and scalability logic behind each historical choice.

item.title: vLLM Online Inference in Production: From Architecture to Token Billing
item.description: A deep dive into vLLM's core architecture (PagedAttention, continuous batching, APC prefix caching, speculative decoding) for online serving. Covers OpenAI-compatible API setup, performance tuning, token billing systems, and complete Docker deployment with Prometheus monitoring.

item.title: Mapping the NVIDIA GPU Driver Stack: From Kernel Modules to Container Runtimes
item.description: A deep dive into the complex Linux NVIDIA GPU driver package structures. Understand the 5-layer architecture bridging nvidia-dkms, libnvidia, nvidia-utils, and driver metapackages. Plus, discover enterprise best practices and troubleshooting guides for 4 core deployment scenarios, including Docker model servers and DGX clusters.

item.title: LLM Quantization Precision Guide: From FP32 to 1-bit, How Much Quality Do You Actually Lose?
item.description: A comprehensive comparison of FP32, BF16, FP16, FP8, INT8, INT4, NF4, FP4, 1.58-bit and all major quantization formats — with real benchmark data and an in-depth FP8 vs INT8 technical analysis.

item.title: 7 Runtime Practices for Building AI Agents
item.description: Based on a real data analysis agent project, this article distills 7 reusable Agent Runtime practices covering state exposure, tool design, context control, guardrails, delegation, and trace-driven iteration.

item.title: MCP Deep Dive: The USB-C Port for AI
item.description: From architecture to hands-on development, a complete guide to the Model Context Protocol. Includes Python SDK tutorial, security mechanisms, and ecosystem comparison.

item.title: Skills Deep Dive: Give Your AI Coding Assistant a Professional Brain
item.description: From core principles to cross-platform practice, a complete guide to the AI coding assistant Skills system. Covers SKILL.md mechanics, six-platform comparison, hands-on writing guide, and best practices.

item.title: Prompt Engineering Practice Guide
item.description: An in-depth exploration of designing effective prompts to improve model output quality. Covers core techniques like Few-Shot, Chain-of-Thought, and ReAct with practical examples.

item.title: Deep Dive into 11 AI Foundation Model Trends in 2026
item.description: From Thinking reasoning modes to Agentic applications, a deep dive into the top 11 trends in AI foundation models for 2026.

item.title: Building AI Agent Applications from Scratch
item.description: A step-by-step guide to building intelligent agent systems using LangChain and the Claude API. Includes complete code and architecture design.

item.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) in Practice: Strategies & Production Best Practices
item.description: A complete guide on how to use retrieval-augmented generation strategies and production best practices. Covers vector databases, semantic chunking, ColBERT reranking, GraphRAG, and automated Ragas evaluation.

item.title: 2026 Mainstream Foundation Models Comparison: GPT-5.4 vs Claude Opus 4.6 vs Gemini 3.1 Pro
item.description: A comprehensive comparison of the top three foundation models in 2026, covering reasoning, coding, context windows, API pricing, and selection strategies.

item.title: Multimodal AI Models Starter Guide
item.description: Explore the vision and text capabilities of multimodal models like GPT-5.4 and Gemini 3.1 Pro, with practical use cases in image and video analysis.

item.title: LLM Fine-Tuning Guide: How It Works, Real-World Use Cases, and Workflows
item.description: Discover how LLM fine-tuning works under the hood, explore proven enterprise use cases (LoRA, QLoRA, Full Fine-Tuning), and learn end-to-end workflows from data preparation to vLLM serving.
